questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including the types of pharmaceutical products you supply, distribute, prescribe or dispense, and any commercial relationships you have with Sun Pharma or Organon.

subpoints.text: quality and characteristics of the ganirelix products that each supply, such as packaging, ease of patient use, shelf life, innovation
other factors such as price, service quality and reliability of supply

questions.text: How closely do Sun Pharma and Organon currently compete in the supply of ganirelix in Australia, taking into account factors such as:

subpoints.text: key existing and potential suppliers of ganirelix in Australia; and
their relative competitive strength now and in the future, having regard to price and non-price factors

questions.text: Is the use of generic ganirelix expected to increase in Australia in the future? In answering this, please address what factors are likely to influence its uptake (for example, availability, factors specific to ganirelix, patient preferences, pharmacy stocking and dispensing practices, and prescriber practices in relation to generic substitution).

Explain whether cetrorelix is a substitute for ganirelix in Australia and whether its use is expected to increase in Australia in the future. Why or why not? Identify any future suppliers of cetrorelix in Australia.

If known, describe the contracting or tendering process for the supply of ganirelix to pharmacies. Include in your response any barriers to pharmacists switching suppliers and the factors that may influence this decision.

Describe the factors that influence whether pharmacists stock branded and/or generic ganirelix products (for example, pricing, discounts or rebates, wholesale distributors and prescriber or patient preferences). If you are part of a pharmacy buying or banner group, as part of your response address how likely it is that ganirelix suppliers not aligned with your group will compete to supply you.
Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including any concerns with any other products supplied by Sun Pharma and Organon.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Describe the extent to which the Ferring Agreement would address any concerns you have in relation to the Acquisition.
Provide your view on how effective Ferring would be in supplying ganirelix in Australia and details of any experience with Ferring in respect of the supply of women’s health products.
